import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    f = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    f.sort()
    idx = (n + 1) // 2 - 1
    print(f[idx])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
